thread:
andrew: quick sync — Enterprise C and a few pilot customers pushed back: they want per-route quotas (chat vs embeddings vs function-calls) and clearer billing for function/tool calling. Need a spec decision by EOD Fri so we can lock roadmap. key questions: token accounting for function calls, whether tool outputs count, and how to represent per-route tiering in API + billing exports.

maria: short answer: current infra only measures model tokens (prompt + model output). tool outputs (e.g., external db results) are not token-billed today. function-call semantics are treated as model output tokens.

jamal: billing POV: customers want an authoritative, line-level field in usage export to avoid parsing raw tokens. propose we introduce `billing_token_count` in usage logs that is the single source of truth for invoicing. must be backward compatible — older customers should still see tokens but not rely on them for invoices.

olivia: from Sales: biggest ask is per-route quotas mapped to API keys and fine-grained alerts (webhook when 80% used). they also want optional per-tool caps (e.g., block tool execution after N calls). can we support route-level burst credits?

raman: engineering constraints: we can add fields to usage and response metadata without major infra changes. enforcement is trickier — we have 3 enforcement planes: 1) gateway rate limit (fast, stateless), 2) quota service (stateful, consistent counters), 3) post-hoc billing adjustments. per-route soft quotas (warn + webhook) are cheap; hard enforcement needs consistent counters and sharding work.

andrew: concrete ask: draft minimal API changes + enforcement model + launch criteria (what must be in place for GA). also need migration story for existing customers using token-calcs in their billing pipelines.

maria: propose spec: (a) add `route_id` header that callers set (server validates), (b) add `billing_token_count` in usage events and in response debug metadata, (c) extend quota API to accept `route_id` and `tool_id` dimensions. small snippet: ```json
{
  "route_id": "chat-webapp-v2",
  "billing_token_count": 1234,
  "tool_id": "sql-runner"
}
```

jamal: +1 on `billing_token_count`. Need to define rounding rules: we bill at token granularity, round up per-request. For function calls: count tokens for the model request + model-produced function_call tokens. Do not bill for external tool output that was ingested back if it wasn't produced by the model. Document this clearly.

olivia: customers will ask for per-route pricing tiers (e.g., chat-high, chat-low). we should expose `route_tier` in the API to allow downstream billing rules. Can marketing/sales map route_tier -> price plan?

raman: technical note: tagging requests with `route_id` is worst-case user-supplied; we need server-side mapping to prevent spoofing. suggest API keys be scope-bound to allowed routes or we validate route_id against route config. enforcement: token counters incremented in quota-service after response streaming completes. this prevents double counting but adds latency to quota visibility.

andrew: launch criteria draft: 1) `billing_token_count` present and documented; 2) quota API supports `route_id` and `tool_id` dims; 3) soft quota webhooks live; 4) migration doc + sample SQL for customers to migrate from raw token parsing -> `billing_token_count`; 5) legal signoff on language around tool outputs. anything else?

jamal: add: billing tests — sample invoices for 5 customer scenarios (with function calls, embeddings, rerank flows). we need to run a dry-run billing month where `billing_token_count` is computed but not invoiced.

maria: dev plan: we can ship response metadata and usage export change in one sprint. quota enforcement (hard limits) needs 2 sprints of work (counter sharding + rollout plan). soft quotas + webhooks = 1 sprint.

ops-bot: deploy-note: quota-service feature-flag `route_quota_v1` created on staging cluster. use `ff-enable route_quota_v1` to test.

andrew: next steps — i'll turn this into a short spec PR with the proposed fields, rounding rules, and GA checklist. @maria @jamal please review before EOD Thu. i'll loop in Legal for tool output language. thanks all :thumbsup:
